scope: Secret handling, plan redaction, private evidence, Queue/log minimization, Access template, retention, and environment-scoped identities

evidence: Repository manifest contains secret names and ownership only, with forbidden Worker bindings
Neon API/Console/CLI/neon_role Worker identity creation is prohibited because automatic neon_superuser membership violates least privilege
The value-free direct-SQL bootstrap creates six distinct LOGIN roles with explicit negative privileges, revokes neon_superuser, and grants only matching NOLOGIN capability roles

A fail-closed catalog attestation rejects superuser, BYPASSRLS, replication, database/role creation, neon_superuser, missing capability, unexpected membership, cross-role login, or cross-environment evidence before Hyperdrive

The runner resolves project, branch, endpoint, direct host, bootstrap identity, database, and login names from exact environment Terraform outputs; it accepts no identity or host override and uses TLS verify-full
SQL, runner, and Terraform share one versioned fixed-order canonical material; Terraform recomputes evidence_sha256 over every bound field and rejects an altered envelope with a reused digest

The attestation binds exact environment, Neon project/branch/endpoint/direct host, six login records, template digest, verification time, and expiry; apply-time timestamp must fall inside a window no longer than 15 minutes
Stale saved-plan, future, overlong, cross-project, cross-branch, cross-endpoint, wrong-host, and same-digest altered attestations are rejected and a later apply requires rerunning SQL
Public configs bind only the attested ushso_public login and no mutation credential is reused
Plan redactor preserves the apply artifact and removes nested credential, origin, account, project, and URI secret material
Private content-addressed capture/archive R2 has no public domain and no blind deletion
Queue bodies are IDs/references only and logging forbids bodies, credentials, questions, and user IDs
Cloudflare Access template uses dedicated ops role/MFA, scoped service token, and final deny-everyone rule
The API-created bootstrap owner is direct-only, may assume ushso_maintenance after verification, and is never a Worker/Hyperdrive binding

required_evidence: Encrypted access-controlled versioned remote state with recovery test
Environment-specific SQL-created secret generation, rotation, and zero-log exposure evidence
State-resolved verify-full attestation-runner receipt for exact project, branch, endpoint, direct host, and all six logins before Hyperdrive
Managed catalog PASS plus negative elevated-role, wrong-host, wrong-endpoint, changed-envelope, and expired-saved-plan binding tests
Cloudflare Access IdP, ops group, MFA, service token, audience, and negative public tests
Managed R2 public-access and custom-domain inspection
Staging grant/binding denials and redacted plan review
Production foundation remains zero traffic and separately scoped

authorization_boundaries.AUTH-02: state, secret values, Access, and identities

non_claims: No secret value was created, read, or committed
No Neon Worker login, state-resolved attestation runner, or catalog attestation was created or run
No Cloudflare Access application or identity-provider membership was created
No remote Terraform state security was exercised
No managed least-privilege or cross-environment negative test has run
